answer: Adopt an arrival jitter ledger. New identities must sustain a distinct request cadence and answer random timing probes, admitted only if that shape stays coherent through a gale of background load. The ledger checks each cadence against a mirror of its own prior week, so a sybil operator pays one persistent connection, probe-response compute, and schedule upkeep per identity. A cadence that flattens or matches a terrace of admitted accounts is revoked.
